name: B10-0217/2026 (PPE) – Shortcomings and deficiencies of the ‘Amnesty Law’ in Venezuela
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on shortcomings and deficiencies of the ‘Amnesty Law’ in Venezuela
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion on Venezuela's "Amnesty Law for Democratic Coexistence", adopted in February 2026. Members say the law is flawed: it does not free all political prisoners, it forces people to admit to false accusations, and it could shield those responsible for human rights abuses. The Parliament calls for the unconditional release of everyone held for political reasons, an end to persecution of the opposition, and no lifting of European Union sanctions until real steps towards democracy are taken.

- The Parliament asks for all political prisoners to be freed; around 470 remain detained.
- It wants sanctions on human rights violators kept until free elections are guaranteed.
- It is an opinion only; European Union governments decide on sanctions and releases.
